name: rea-playspace
description: A visual node-and-edge playspace for exploring Valueflows and REA accounting

scripts.build: cd modules/state-management && pnpm build && cd - && cd modules/typed-object-tweezers && pnpm build && cd - && cd modules/react-table && pnpm build && cd - && cd modules/valueflows-models && pnpm build && cd - && cd modules/data-providers && pnpm build && cd - && cd modules/yaati && pnpm build && cd - && cd app && pnpm build && cd -
scripts.web-zip: pnpm run web-build && cd app/dist && zip -r ../ui.zip .
